The 'deamidation' at Asparagine (N) is the critical signature of the PNGase F cleavage used to identify surface-exposed sites. While the authors report 'protein abundance', the underlying data is site-specific (N-glycopeptides), making 'log2fc_site' the most accurate differential engine.
